reviews.text: A very professional and courteous doctor!

The vet who has been treating all our animals for over 10 years for me, and even longer for my husband.

We are very happy with the care and qualifications of our vet.

Having dealt with other practices, I find him much more reasonable in terms of treatment and respect for the animals.

I'm always surprised by the difference; we never feel like we're just a bank account to be drained.

Of course, veterinary care is expensive everywhere, but I don't feel ripped off, and above all, our animals are very well cared for.

Incompetent vet.

I needed a vet to travel abroad with my cat.

Not only did this vet know nothing about the regulations and mandatory treatments, but he acted as if he were an expert. I had to go back and pay for additional emergency consultations before I could leave. Avoid at all costs.

I hesitated for a long time before writing this review, but I think it's important to share it.

First, after making an appointment, I arrived at the clinic at the same time as another owner and their dog. Apparently, this person was a "long-time client," so they were given priority.

My appointment was for my two-and-a-half-month-old puppy's booster vaccination. After discussing which vaccines to administer, I asked, on the breeder's advice, for a preventative treatment against giardiasis. That's when the appointment took an unpleasant turn: the veterinarian began questioning my breeder's professionalism and competence in a persistent and rather inappropriate manner.

During the vaccination, my puppy, who had been perfectly fine until then, suddenly lost consciousness: he collapsed, soiled himself, and became unresponsive. The vet, visibly panicked, tried to revive him by putting drops in his nose, without really explaining what he was doing. (Strange to panic so much while doing absolutely nothing for someone with so many years of experience.)

Once my puppy was awake, he continued to blame the breeder and claimed it wasn't a reaction to the vaccine, but certainly a heart problem. He then advised me to have tests done at the Mermoz clinic or another one in Caluire, specifying that it would cost between €500 and €700 (but that it was essential).

Faced with this situation, and being a first-time dog owner, I was completely lost and worried. Fortunately, I consulted another vet, who explained that my puppy had simply had a stress reaction to the vaccine, combined with a mild case of gastroenteritis.

In summary, I found this veterinarian extremely unprofessional: lack of composure in the face of an emergency, failure to provide clear explanations, inappropriate judgments about other professionals, and questionable advice.

Therefore, I do not recommend this practitioner due to their lack of judgment and professionalism.
Thank you very much. Excellent vet, I highly recommend him.

I brought my daughter's puppy in for its first vaccinations. This veterinarian took the time to get to know the little dog, examining him thoroughly with professionalism and kindness. He gave me a lot of helpful advice. I'm delighted that my daughter can have her dog seen by this veterinarian.
Excellent vet, he's been treating my animals for 10 years. He's pleasant, attentive, and very gentle with animals. I recommend him without hesitation.
A kind, patient, competent and responsive veterinarian.

A pleasant, kind, and attentive veterinarian.

He takes the time needed for us and our animals. I recommend him 100%.
A very attentive vet who provides a lot of information! Also very kind
We arrived with a pigeon at closing time and were very well received. He saved the pigeon. Thank you again, Doctor, you're wonderful! 🙂 …

Dr. Badra did a wonderful job treating my dog. In 2015, when my dog ​​had a fever of over 40°C (104°F), the doctor gave him injections. He even came out on a Sunday. I can't thank him enough. My beloved dog passed away on September 28th. I'm getting another one. Dr. Badra will be taking care of him. If my future dog ever has any serious health problems, I'll take him to the Mermoz Vet clinic.
